messages.subject: ui.R only for a segment of the website/for a single file in the www folder, also uploading files
parts:
Hi everyone.

I've created a website that is able to load individual html pages into a segment on my main page, like this:

<article id="content"> </article>
...
<script type="text/javascript"> $('#content').load('start.html'); </script>

Is there any way to attach a ui.R file to one of those individual pages, so that only that single page will have the ui created dynamically?

I am asking because I'd like one of those pages to look much like the "Uploading Files" example (09_upload) from the tutorial, but I haven't yet figured out a way to upload a file using only html for the ui.

Thanks,

Markus

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: ui.R only for a segment of the website/for a single file in the www folder, also uploading files
parts:
I don't think this can work. Not because you can't write the jQuery to load the URL that is served by ui.R--you can--but because when the HTML that is generated by ui.R is loaded into the page, it won't work correctly. It's running from a totally different URL than it is expecting, so none of the relative paths will work (including the one to connect back to the server), and the document's onready event has already fired, which Shiny waits for to initialize all of its controls.

Can you do an iframe instead?
